desc: A Lua mod (mods/lua-print) prints thousands of arguments at once (print(table.unpack(t))) and lives on: print joins as it goes, so a C function's 20 guaranteed stack slots are never passed (it wrote past Lua's stack once); require finds lua/parts/helper.lua and names the missing module's path; ttyd.message set to two texts in turn 2000 times keeps both (by content: a battle menu row may hold either), and a 100 KB text is refused with a Lua error
log_must: lua: \[dev\.ttyd\.lua-print\] lua-print: missing false .*the mod has no lua/parts/missing\.lua
lua: \[dev\.ttyd\.lua-print\] lua-print: message big false .*ttyd\.message: refused
